issuesSettings.githubIssuesDescription: Automatically create GitHub Issues for vulnerabilities detected during scans. Issues will be created in your linked repository.
issuesSettings.gitlabIssuesDescription: Automatically create GitLab Issues for vulnerabilities detected during scans. Issues will be created in your linked repository.
issuesSettings.issueGroupingModeDescription: Choose how vulnerabilities should be grouped when creating issues.

modeOptions.perVulnerabilityTypeDesc: Group all occurrences of the same vulnerability type into a single issue. Recommended for most projects.
modeOptions.perVulnerabilityDesc: Create a separate issue for each individual vulnerability detection. Best for SCA dependencies.
modeOptions.perFileDesc: Group all vulnerabilities in the same file into a single issue.

issuesSettings.jiraIssuesDescription: Create Jira tickets for vulnerabilities detected during scans. Select which Jira project should receive the tickets.
issuesSettings.jiraBranchInfo: Jira tickets will only be created for scans on {{count}} branch(es): {{branches}}
issuesSettings.jiraAutoCreateDescription: When enabled, Jira tickets will be automatically created for new vulnerabilities detected during scans.
issuesSettings.jiraConfigured: Configured: tickets will be created in {{project}}
issuesSettings.linearIssuesDescription: Create Linear tickets for vulnerabilities detected during scans. Select the Linear team that should receive them.
issuesSettings.linearBranchInfo: Linear tickets will only be created for scans on {{count}} branch(es): {{branches}}
issuesSettings.linearAutoCreateDescription: When enabled, Linear tickets will be automatically created for new vulnerabilities detected during scans.
issuesSettings.linearConfigured: Configured: tickets will be created in {{team}}
issuesSettings.linearConfiguredInProject: Configured: tickets will be created in {{team}}, in the project {{project}}
issuesSettings.infoDescription: When enabled, issues will be automatically created after each scan. Issues are also automatically closed when vulnerabilities are resolved.

branchSelection.title: Branch Selection
branchSelection.description: Select on which branches issues should be created. Leave empty to create issues on all branches.
branchSelection.label: Target branches
branchSelection.info: Issues will be created only on {{count}} selected branch(es)
